title: Kitchen
notes: Each device already has a control. A null id means Not set up: the model stays off and the hub is not called. Put the entity id in and the same control starts working. Washer and dryer are status only: they never send a command, and the drums spin when the hub says that entity is running. climate_entity_id is the thermostat.

range_hood_light.note: Hood light level. select.set only accepts Off, Dim, or High, because those are the options the device publishes.

washer.note: Read only. Set the id to the washer entity the hub reports. The drum spins while it is running.

dryer.note: Read only. Set the id to the dryer entity the hub reports. The drum spins while it is running.

not_in_model.name: Kitchen Table Wall
not_in_model.note: In the main-floor scenes. The booth pendant is light.kitchen_table_overhead, not this wall light.

not_in_model.name: Kitchen Table
